# NYC Taxi — Revenue by Payment Type

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Revenue breakdown by payment method

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  payment_type,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
  SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue,
  SUM(tip_amount) AS total_tips,
  AVG(tip_amount / NULLIF(fare_amount, 0)) * 100 AS avg_tip_percentage
FROM trips
WHERE
  pickup_datetime >= '2019-10-08'
  AND pickup_datetime < '2019-11-07'
  AND fare_amount > 0
GROUP BY
  payment_type
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC
```
